cleanup.policy: Only exact known raw JFR/collapsed/heap filenames in four previous project result roots. Reports, logs, resources, all derived data, receipts and user run-debug are preserved. No recursive broad deletion.

semanticScope: No selected semantic change. Native ordering, C2/C5, protection, ND AND, effects and prepared routing obligations checked by native differential and regression tests. Finite Lean models do not verify the JVM implementation.
performance: Not measured yet; implementation tests do not establish a speedup.
counterQualifications: Prepared c5RowAttempts/c5Candidates/c5Restrict count output-program finalization visits, including empty buckets; not old per-row full restrictions.
K/k/s counters cover successful preparations; explicit factory fallback reasons omit cache hits and scratch pre-factory oversize requests.
Prepared scalar and stream counters cover prepared execution attempts, not every native fallback.
localPublicationCandidatePairs/localPublicationLinearPairs compare publication-side DATA pairs; localCandidatePairs also includes offer-side DATA.
localNdCombinations counts complete binding/output emission pairs, including upgrades, not unique Cartesian binding tuples.
